summary: Frontend-only smoke test of the OBS Control Deck web panel. Page loads correctly, all three tabs (Auto Switch, Timer, Materiale) render without any React runtime crashes, and connection failure to a non-existent OBS server is handled gracefully. No blank/white screen at any point. Zero uncaught JS exceptions (0 pageerror events).

issues: When connection fails, inline error label reads just 'Error' with no reason; activity log correctly shows 'Conectare esuata: Error'. Minor UX polish, non-blocking.

action_items: No code fix required for the reported bug 'nu se deschide nici o pagina'. Could not reproduce — page opens and all tabs render cleanly. Advise user to (a) confirm they are using the public URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, (b) hard-refresh/clear cache & unregister any stale service workers, (c) try a different browser or disable extensions. Optionally: surface a descriptive OBS connect error message instead of just 'Error'.
critical_code_review_comments: ConnectionBar surfaces a generic 'Error' string when OBS connect fails; should pass through obs-websocket error.message for better diagnostics.
Expected ws:// ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED console error is emitted on Connect click without OBS — acceptable but could be caught to keep console clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testid selectors verified present & working: app-root, tabs-nav, connection-card, log-card, tab-switch/tab-timer/tab-materials, autoswitch-tab/timer-tab/materials-tab, timer-display (shows '05:00'), add-rule-btn, rule-source-0, rule-target-0, rule-remove-0, autoswitch-arm-btn (correctly disabled without scene), input-host, input-port, input-password, connect-btn. Only console output: React DevTools info + expected WebSocket ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED after Connect click (no OBS in this env). Zero pageerror across tab switches and after failed connect.
rca of the issue: Could NOT reproduce user report 'nu se deschide nici o pagina'. Public URL https://play-to-main.preview.emergentagent.com renders full UI, all three tabs switch without crashing, no white screen, no JS exceptions. Likely user-side causes: stale service worker / cached JS, corporate network or browser extension blocking the preview domain / WebSocket, or user opening a stale URL. Not a code bug in current build.
